scope: same approved workbook and sheet only; read-only local analysis

progress_field_groups: Contractor Plan Progress%: Last Period, This Period, Cumulative
Actual Progress: Last Period, This Period, Cumulative
volume_field_groups: Activities Plan Volume: BOQ, Last Period, This Period, Cumulative
Activities Actual Volume: This Period, Cumulative
weekly volume: until previous week, this week, until this week

reporting_period_semantics.evidence: Workbook labels identify start and end of week; individual row date-plan fields are separate planned start/finish dates.
reporting_period_semantics.persian_calendar_date_role: 1402/06/31 is the workbook-labelled end of the reporting week, not inferred from filesystem metadata.

limitations: Workbook schema does not establish source authority or present-day currentness.
Actual Progress is a labelled source field and is not interpreted as proof that an action was completed.
Raw workbook values, formulas, locators, and revised review cards remain outside Git.
